RA1.label: Information and guidance provided

RA1.1.label: Step-by-step instructions provided
RA1.1.description: Agent walked the customer through a process with specific steps to resolve their issue.

RA1.2.label: Product capability or limitation clarified
RA1.2.description: Agent explained what the product can or cannot do, resolving a capability misunderstanding.

RA1.3.label: Directed to documentation or self-service
RA1.3.description: Agent pointed the customer to a help article, FAQ, knowledge base, or self-service tool.

RA1.4.label: Policy or terms explained
RA1.4.description: Agent clarified a company policy, contract term, or service agreement that the customer questioned.

RA1.description: The agent resolved the issue by providing information, instructions, or clarification rather than taking a system or account action.

RA2.label: Account or system action taken

RA2.1.label: Credentials reset or access restored
RA2.1.description: Agent reset a password, unlocked an account, or restored system access for the customer.

RA2.2.label: Account settings or configuration modified
RA2.2.description: Agent changed a setting, preference, or configuration on the customer's account.

RA2.3.label: Billing credit or adjustment applied
RA2.3.description: Agent applied a credit note, price adjustment, or billing correction to the account.

RA2.4.label: Refund processed or initiated
RA2.4.description: Agent processed or formally initiated a refund for an eligible charge.

RA2.5.label: Account details or profile updated
RA2.5.description: Agent updated personal details, contact information, or profile data on the account.

RA2.6.label: Subscription or plan changed
RA2.6.description: Agent upgraded, downgraded, paused, or modified the customer's subscription or plan tier.

RA2.description: The agent performed a direct action on the customer's account or in the company's systems.

RA3.label: Escalation or specialist action

RA3.1.label: Transferred to specialist or second-line team
RA3.1.description: Customer or case was transferred to a specialist team with the relevant expertise.

RA3.2.label: Engineering or technical ticket raised
RA3.2.description: A bug report, technical investigation ticket, or change request was logged for the engineering team.

RA3.3.label: Escalated to supervisor or manager
RA3.3.description: A manager or senior agent took over the case or was brought in to assist.

RA3.4.label: Formal case or investigation opened
RA3.4.description: A formal investigation was opened for a complex issue requiring multi-step review.

RA3.description: The issue was beyond the agent's authority or capability and was escalated or referred to a specialist.

RA4.label: Workaround or alternative solution

RA4.1.label: Workaround or manual fix provided
RA4.1.description: Agent provided a temporary workaround that allows the customer to proceed without the permanent fix.

RA4.2.label: Alternative product, feature, or plan offered
RA4.2.description: Agent offered an alternative that meets the customer's need, though not the originally requested solution.

RA4.3.label: Callback or follow-up scheduled as interim
RA4.3.description: Agent scheduled a callback or follow-up as a holding action while the main resolution is arranged.

RA4.description: The ideal resolution was not available, so the agent provided a workaround or alternative.

RA5.label: Complaint or goodwill handling

RA5.1.label: Formal apology and acknowledgement provided
RA5.1.description: Agent offered a sincere, explicit apology for the issue or inconvenience caused.

RA5.2.label: Goodwill gesture offered
RA5.2.description: Agent offered a credit, discount, free upgrade, or other goodwill gesture beyond standard entitlement.

RA5.3.label: Complaint formally logged
RA5.3.description: Agent formally registered the customer's complaint in the company's system for tracking and review.

RA5.description: The agent took specific action to acknowledge and address the customer's dissatisfaction beyond the functional issue itself.

RA6.label: No resolution action taken

RA6.1.label: Policy limitation — cannot fulfil request
RA6.1.description: The customer's request is outside what company policy allows; the agent explained but could not act.

RA6.2.label: Outside scope — redirected to correct resource
RA6.2.description: The issue is outside this team's scope; the customer was redirected to the appropriate channel.

RA6.3.label: Customer declined offered resolution
RA6.3.description: The agent offered a valid resolution but the customer chose not to accept it.

RA6.description: The agent was unable or chose not to take a resolution action. The interaction ended without a concrete resolution step.
